_why: CLOSED vocabulary: add a tag here first, never freelance one in an entry (lettuce TAXONOMY.md rule). Stations add tags in map/station_tags.json.

problems.closeout: end a pass: ledger, defects, handoff, asides
problems.delegation: summon subagents by protocol: size, tier, contract, heartbeat
problems.doc-truth: do the documents' path and code claims still resolve?
problems.falsification-register: never lose a falsification; check it before testing again
problems.governance-audit: one runner, one exit code: which checks are red?
problems.hook-safety: stop an irreversible or wrong-place act before it happens
problems.kit-assembly: build, zip, verify and bootstrap the kit and its branches
problems.licence-compliance: may this be held, exported, combined?
problems.map-freshness: are the generated maps and indexes true to the tree right now?
problems.memory-retrieval: what did we already learn, decide or refute about this?
problems.orientation: what is this station for and what do I do first?
problems.prior-art: is this already built, tried or held upstream?
problems.routing: which first move does this prompt need, which station?
problems.rule-ownership: which file owns this rule, and what enforces it?
problems.session-continuity: where did the last session stop, and what is NEXT?
problems.skill-routing: which of the census skills answers this, and where does it live?
problems.station-sync: bring commons changes to a station without a broken merge
problems.upstream-intake: bring a new upstream in: licence, lane, neutralisation, provenance
problems.upstream-pinning: which exact commit is held, and has it been edited?
problems.usage-observation: is this tool/skill/upstream actually used, declared or observed?
problems.colour-contrast: does every text/UI colour pair meet its WCAG contrast threshold?
problems.design-detector: does this HTML/CSS carry a known anti-pattern (impeccable's 59 rules), measured, scored, with a verdict exit code?
problems.design-handoff: hand a design to the station that builds it: one package format, one token schema
problems.design-method: which held design method (impeccable command, emil skill) answers this design question?
problems.market-scan: size a market or scan competitors with every figure sourced, denominated and re-derivable
problems.site-protection: protect a site the operator owns: fair bot handling, rate limits, hardening, privacy, passive self-check
problems.ui-critique: is this UI right, and what exactly is wrong with it, with evidence?
problems.target-memory: decipher a repo or folder once and keep its index and wiki as memory every station can read
